checks.note: serverId must match a manifest-configured server (registry.ts:107); reportedName is only logged. Duplicate keys are rejected in add() rather than overwritten (registry.ts:138-141).

add() rejects same bare names and canonicalized lookalikes (case, NFKC, rn/vv, digit confusables, separators stripped, edit distance <=1) across servers; the scanner also gets bareNamesExcept(serverId). Nothing is silently overwritten. Transposition-style lookalikes can slip through, but the check asks for case, homoglyph and separator coverage and that is present.

Allowlist and highImpactTools use the namespaced key. executor.ts looks up registry.get(call.name) and checkApproval compares rec.tool to call.name, which includes the verified serverId. A different server gets a different key, so it inherits no approval and cannot replace the tool.

note: I found no way around the verified-server namespacing, the duplicate/lookalike rejection, or the approval binding.
